title: Dual closure of Zpk-bent functions
summary: Determine whether the dual of every Zpk-bent function remains Zpk-bent once the exponent k is at least two.

formal_statement.body: Let $p$ be an odd prime and $k\ge2$. For every $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$-bent function $f$ in the source domain, must its dual $f^*$ also be $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$-bent? Prove closure under the dual operation, or construct a $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$-bent function whose dual is not $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$-bent.

assumptions: $f$ is $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$-bent under the source definition
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later work proves that every such dual remains $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$-bent or supplies a counterexample to closure.

citations.label: Wang--Fu, further problems on generalized-bent duals
citations.locator: Conclusion, journal p. 4781, second further problem

progress.summary: The source asks whether $\mathbb Z_{p^k}$-bentness is preserved by duality for every $k\ge2$, explicitly allowing a counterexample.
